name: Serrated Blade
textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. If the target has Bleed: apply {bleed} more Bleed.
flavor:
Saw-backed blade from the forges beneath the Bastion ridge.

Weald smiths filed its teeth for clearing briar, and the Wardens took it up when the Blight came out of the woods. The smiths were never paid for the change of use.

How the briar learned to bleed, the smiths will not speak of.
